key_terms: The DAG setting that creates runs for historical scheduled intervals when the DAG becomes active. Airflow 3 defaults it to False, so the workshop sets catchup=True explicitly.
An explicit request to run a DAG over a historical date range under its own run controls, separate from the regular schedule.
A manually triggered run that rewrites one validated day, keeping the scope of the change visible instead of hiding it in a wall-clock timestamp.
The recorded old and new source identities and the authorizing workflow for a replaced partition, so a material historical revision is not concealed.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
